name: Quad 4 Plastics
old_description: produces high-quality products with engineering, design and manufacturing expertise.
about:
Quad 4 Plastics operates from Elkhart, Indiana, where it runs two production plants and a distribution warehouse. The company describes itself as a "powerful partner for over 20 years," though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founders are not disclosed.

The firm provides custom plastic injection molding, thermoforming, and vacuum forming, including insert molding and precision trimming of thermoformed parts. It supports projects from initial sketches through CAD/CAM design, tooling fabrication, and finishing, and adds assembly, packaging, and nationwide distribution from its Elkhart warehouse. The operation specializes in medium- to heavy-gauge thermoplastic parts and emphasizes quick turnarounds.

Quad 4 serves customers in construction furniture, LPG and NH3 equipment, electronics, marine, recreational vehicle, automotive, and general furniture sectors. Its components range from small, complex aesthetic parts to large structural pieces.

The company positions itself on end-to-end capability—design, molding, finishing, and logistics under one roof—to safeguard product integrity and lower production costs. It highlights continuous improvement, adoption of new technology, and ethical business practices as core to its approach.
